TGO.note: Verification is only an intended use; no authentication service stated in service.
Data protection is mentioned only as a guarantee to be kept; no law stated.
Cash transfers are named only as an envisaged use of the ID number.
Gives cards produced and distributed (4.72m of 5.9m), which the document says is not a share of the population; no count of people enrolled.
ANID leads the programme, but nothing on who operates or maintains the system day to day.
Use by registers is only an intended aim; none stated in use.

facts.fact: La Cinquieme reports that the national biometric identification programme run by the ANID gives a unique identification number (NIU) to each registered person, with 5.9 million cards produced and 4.72 million distributed as of 21 October 2026.

TGO.note: Uses by banks and agencies are only envisaged.
No programme management information system named.
